protocol.prompt: Describe the image in one sentence.
protocol.focus: t>=1 only, original Full next token
protocol.sampling: Select input-hash ordered original frozen COCO confirmation images with no prior Discovery checkpoint; verify official annotation, byte SHA256 and RGB. One image/SHA. Exactly50 per GPU by sorted selection index modulo4. Smoke image disjoint.
protocol.alignment: Fast tokenizer decoded-caption roundtrip IDs must exactly equal native generated non-special IDs. Offset overlap with ASCII lexical word spans; main only one original token exactly covering a complete unambiguous lexicon word after trimming whitespace. Multi-token/unknown/punctuation/special/EOS retained in audit, never tails as words.
protocol.labels: Frozen offline explicit lexicons v1. Relation/action takes priority over Function then Visual; on/in/at/with/over/under are Relation. Ambiguous lexical homographs excluded. Visual words are candidates, not verified grounding. No external generative annotator.
protocol.position_selection: Per image input-hash anchor in relative position[.1,.9]. Within each available class choose nearest generation position to same anchor, ties fixed hash. Never use confidence, entropy or interventions. At most one/class/image, no replacement. Freeze all positions before formal ablation.
protocol.intervention: Whole zeros only current query o_proj at one layer. Image subtracts bias-free Wo applied to original post-softmax image weights times original V, accumulated/projected FP32 and subtract/cast once to native FP16; never renormalize. All32 zeros only current query outputs in all32 layers. MLP/residual/weights untouched; no free continuation.
protocol.cache: Replay entire native Full track. t consumes generated[t-1] at original absolute position. Every condition deep clones identical parent history. Per-call metadata/version/no-alias checks; parent SHA256 before/after each target. All replay logits must equal saved native FP32 logits bit-exactly. Throw away intervened caches.
protocol.numerical: No-op/observer logits bit-exact; eager row sum tolerance inherited .002. Decomposition bound from FP16 rounding u=2^-11 and FP32 dot gamma_n=n*2^-24/(1-n*2^-24), including subnormal half-ULP2^-25. Head and projection checks both required, no data-fitted atol. TF32 off. FP32 finite logits/logsoftmax/JS; JS clamp only within existing1e-6 round bound.
protocol.analysis: Primary Visual-Function Whole mean across nine layers, same-image paired; also per-layer and Image. Image-cluster bootstrap10000, ordinary95% plus Bonferroni family22 (four global raw/adjusted contrasts plus18 mode-layer contrasts). Never heads/layers as independent images. Relation secondary descriptive.
protocol.controlled_model: Within-image fixed-effect OLS on per-position nine-layer mean, role dummies Visual/Relation, centered/scaled controls; drop only constant columns (token_length=1 by design). Image-pairs cluster bootstrap weighted sufficient statistics. Report rank/condition, fixed rcond1e-10; no causal role claim.
protocol.severe: All32 logP loss>=1 nat (>=63.2% Full-token relative probability loss). Also report>.1 and>.5, flips and all tails.
protocol.near_unchanged: Observed All32 abs_delta_logp<=.01 AND no Top1Flip AND JS<=1e-4. Descriptive examples, not safety certification.
protocol.limits: Native-generated-token conditional mechanism study; no final answer accuracy, grounding guarantee, train, layer search, freely intervened generation, kernel skipping or acceleration claim.
